sentences.zh: 天福六年秋七月己未朔，帝御崇元殿視朝。

translations.literal: In autumn, on the first day of the seventh month of the sixth year of Tianfu (day jiwei, new moon), the emperor attended court in the Chongyuan Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the seventh month of autumn in Tianfu 6, the emperor held court in the Chongyuan Hall.

sentences.zh: 庚申，升陳州為防禦使額。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Chenzhou was promoted to defense commissioner status.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Chenzhou was raised to defense-commissioner rank.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以前鄧州節度使焦方為貝州節度使。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Jiao Fang, former military commissioner of Dengzhou, was made military commissioner of Beizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, former Dengzhou commissioner Jiao Fang was appointed military commissioner of Beizhou.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，涇州奏，西涼府留後李文謙，今年二月四日閉宅門自焚，遣元入西涼府譯語官與來人賫三部族蕃書進之。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Jingzhou memorialized that Li Wenqian, acting commissioner of Xiliang Prefecture, on the fourth day of the second month of this year closed his house gates and burned himself to death; he had sent an envoy into Xiliang Prefecture together with an interpreter and the visitor, bearing tribal documents of three clans to present them.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Jingzhou reported that Li Wenqian, acting commissioner of Xiliang, had shut his gates and burned himself to death on the fourth day of the second month of this year; an envoy sent into Xiliang with an interpreter and a visiting party had presented tribal documents from three clans.

sentences.zh: 以三司使劉審交為陳州防禦使。

translations.literal: Liu Shenjiao, Commissioner of the Three Departments, was made defense commissioner of Chenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Shenjiao, Commissioner of the Three Departments, was appointed defense commissioner of Chenzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以前鄆州節度使趙在禮為許州節度使，以前鄴都留守、廣晉尹高行周為河南尹、西都留守。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Zhao Zaili, former military commissioner of Yanzhou, was made military commissioner of Xuzhou; Gao Xingzhou, former defender of Yedu and prefect of Guangjin, was made prefect of Henan and defender of the Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, former Yanzhou commissioner Zhao Zaili became commissioner of Xuzhou, and Gao Xingzhou, former Yedu defender and Guangjin prefect, became Henan prefect and defender of the Western Capital.

sentences.zh: 詔改拱辰、威和、內直等軍並為興順。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that the armies Gongchen, Weihe, Neizhi, and others all be renamed Xingshun.
translations.idiomatic: An edict renamed the Gongchen, Weihe, Neizhi, and related armies collectively as Xingshun.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以宣徽使、權西京留守張從恩判三司。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Zhang Cong'en, Palace Attendant and acting defender of the Western Capital, was assigned to oversee the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Palace Attendant and acting Western Capital defender Zhang Cong'en was put in charge of the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以鄴都留守兼侍衛親軍馬步軍都指揮使、廣晉尹劉知遠為太原尹，充北京留守、河東節度使，仍割遼、沁二州卻隸河東。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Liu Zhiyuan, defender of Yedu and concurrently commander of the Palace Guard horse and foot armies and prefect of Guangjin, was made prefect of Taiyuan, appointed defender of the Northern Capital and military commissioner of Hedong, and the two prefectures Liao and Qin were cut off and returned to Hedong jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Yedu defender Liu Zhiyuan—who also commanded the Palace Guard horse and foot armies and served as Guangjin prefect—was made Taiyuan prefect, defender of the Northern Capital, and Hedong commissioner, with Liao and Qin prefectures restored to Hedong's jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 以北京留守李德充為廣晉尹，充鄴都留守；

translations.literal: Li Dechong, defender of the Northern Capital, was made prefect of Guangjin and appointed defender of Yedu;
translations.idiomatic: Northern Capital defender Li Dechong was made Guangjin prefect and appointed Yedu defender;

sentences.zh: 以昭義節度使馬全節為邢州節度使，加同平章事。

translations.literal: Ma Quanjie, military commissioner of Zhaoyi, was made military commissioner of Xingzhou and given the additional title of Vice Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaoyi commissioner Ma Quanjie was transferred to Xingzhou and promoted to Vice Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，詔：「今後諸道行軍副使，不得奏薦骨肉為殿直供奉官。」

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, an edict stated: "Henceforth deputy commanders on campaign in the various circuits may not memorialize recommending their kin as palace attendants or tribute officers."
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, an edict declared: "Hereafter, deputy field commanders in the circuits may not recommend close relatives for appointment as palace attendants or tribute officers."

sentences.zh: 己卯，以前陜州節度使李從敏為昭義軍節度使，以陜州節度使景延廣為河陽三城節度使兼侍衛親軍馬步軍都虞候，以河陽節度使石赟為陜州節度使。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Li Congmin, former military commissioner of Shanzhou, was made military commissioner of the Zhaoyi army; Jing Yanguang, military commissioner of Shanzhou, was made military commissioner of the Three Cities of Heyang and concurrently chief adjutant of the Palace Guard horse and foot armies; Shi Yun, military commissioner of Heyang, was made military commissioner of Shanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, former Shanzhou commissioner Li Congmin became Zhaoyi commissioner; Shanzhou commissioner Jing Yanguang became Heyang Three Cities commissioner and chief adjutant of the Palace Guard; and Heyang commissioner Shi Yun was transferred to Shanzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬午，突厥遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On day renwu, the Turks sent envoys to present tribute at court.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, the Turks sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 以遙領壽州忠正軍節度使兼侍衛馬軍都指揮使李懷忠為同州節度使，以宣徽北院使李守貞遙領忠正軍節度使、侍衛馬軍指揮使。

translations.literal: Li Huaizhong, titular military commissioner of the Zhongzheng army at Shouzhou and concurrently commander of the Palace Guard cavalry, was made military commissioner of Tongzhou; Li Shouzhen, Attendant of the Northern Palace Bureau, was given titular command of the Zhongzheng army and the Palace Guard cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Li Huaizhong, titular Zhongzheng commissioner at Shouzhou and commander of the Palace Guard cavalry, was appointed Tongzhou commissioner; Palace Northern Bureau attendant Li Shouzhen was given titular Zhongzheng command and cavalry command.

sentences.zh: 甲申，降御劄，取八月五日暫幸鄴都，沿路供頓，並委所司以官物排比，州縣不得科率人戶。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, an imperial rescript was issued: a temporary visit to Yedu was set for the fifth day of the eighth month; supplies along the route were all to be arranged by the responsible offices from government stores, and prefectures and counties might not levy the populace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, the emperor issued a rescript scheduling a temporary visit to Yedu on the fifth day of the eighth month; provisioning along the route was to come from official stores through the responsible agencies, and local governments were forbidden to impose levies on households.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以右諫議大夫趙遠為中書舍人，吏部郎中鄭受益為右諫議大夫，刑部郎中殷鵬為水部郎中、知制誥。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Zhao Yuan, Right Remonstrance Censor, was made Secretariat Drafter; Zheng Shouyi, Director in the Ministry of Personnel, was made Right Remonstrance Censor; Yin Peng, Director in the Ministry of Justice, was made Director in the Ministry of Works with charge of drafting imperial documents.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Right Remonstrance Censor Zhao Yuan became Secretariat Drafter; Personnel Director Zheng Shouyi became Right Remonstrance Censor; and Justice Director Yin Peng became Works Director with charge of drafting edicts.

sentences.zh: 八月戊子朔，以皇子開封尹、鄭王重貴為東京留守，以天平軍節度使兼侍衛親軍馬步軍副都指揮使杜重威為侍衛親軍馬步軍都指揮使，以宣徽南院使張從恩為東京內外兵馬都監。

translations.literal: On the first day of the eighth month (day wuzi, new moon), the prince, prefect of Kaifeng and Prince of Zheng, Chonggui, was made defender of the Eastern Capital; Du Chongwei, military commissioner of the Tianping army and deputy commander of the Palace Guard horse and foot armies, was made commander of the Palace Guard horse and foot armies; Zhang Cong'en, Attendant of the Southern Palace Bureau, was made overall supervisor of military affairs inside and outside the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the eighth month, Prince Chonggui of Zheng, Kaifeng prefect, was appointed Eastern Capital defender; Tianping commissioner and Palace Guard deputy commander Du Chongwei became Palace Guard commander; and Southern Palace Bureau attendant Zhang Cong'en was made overall military supervisor for the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 改奉德馬軍為護聖。

translations.literal: The Fengde cavalry army was renamed Husheng.
translations.idiomatic: The Fengde cavalry was renamed Husheng.

sentences.zh: 放文武百官朝參，取便先赴鄴都。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials were released from court attendance and permitted to proceed to Yedu at their convenience ahead of the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials were excused from court and allowed to travel to Yedu ahead of the imperial procession at their convenience.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，車駕發東京。

translations.literal: On day renchen, the imperial carriage departed the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, the emperor left the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 己亥，至鄴，左右金吾六軍儀仗排列如儀，迎引入內。

translations.literal: On day jihai, [the emperor] arrived at Ye; the Left and Right Golden Crow armies and the Six Armies arrayed their ceremonial guards according to protocol and welcomed him in.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, the emperor reached Ye, where the Golden Crow guards and Six Armies formed ceremonial ranks as prescribed and escorted him within.

sentences.zh: 改舊澶州為德清軍。

translations.literal: The former Cangzhou was renamed the Deqing army.
translations.idiomatic: Former Cangzhou was redesignated the Deqing army.

sentences.zh: 以內客省使劉遂清為宣徽北院使，判三司。

translations.literal: Liu Suiqing, Commissioner of the Inner Guests Bureau, was made Attendant of the Northern Palace Bureau and assigned to oversee the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: Inner Guests Commissioner Liu Suiqing became Northern Palace Bureau attendant with charge of the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，制：「應天福六年八月十五日昧爽已前，諸色罪犯，常赦所不原者，咸赦除之；

translations.literal: On day renyin, an edict stated: "All offenders of every category before dawn on the fifteenth day of the eighth month of the sixth year of Tianfu, even those normally excluded from routine amnesties, are all to be pardoned and released;
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, an edict proclaimed: "Before dawn on the fifteenth day of the eighth month of Tianfu 6, every class of offender—including crimes ordinarily beyond routine amnesty—is to be pardoned and released;

sentences.zh: 其持仗行劫及殺人賊，並免罪移鄉，配逐處軍都收管；

translations.literal: those who committed armed robbery or murder were likewise pardoned and transferred to other districts, assigned to local army commanders for custody;
translations.idiomatic: armed robbers and murderers were likewise pardoned but relocated and placed under local army command;

sentences.zh: 犯枉法贓者，雖免罪不得再任用；

translations.literal: those guilty of unlawful bribes, though pardoned, might not be employed again;
translations.idiomatic: those convicted of unlawful graft, though freed, were barred from future office;

sentences.zh: 諸徒流人並放還；

translations.literal: all those sentenced to penal servitude or exile were released and sent home;
translations.idiomatic: all prisoners sentenced to penal servitude or exile were released;

sentences.zh: 貶降官未量移與量移者，約資敘用。

translations.literal: demoted officials, whether not yet transferred or already transferred, were to be considered for reinstatement according to qualification.
translations.idiomatic: demoted officials, whether awaiting transfer or already transferred, were to be considered for reinstatement in due course.

sentences.zh: 天福五年終已前殘稅並放。

translations.literal: All outstanding taxes before the end of the fifth year of Tianfu were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: All tax arrears due before the close of Tianfu 5 were canceled.

sentences.zh: 應河東起義之初及收復鄴都、汜水立功將校，並與加恩；

translations.literal: officers and soldiers who had rendered merit at the beginning of the Hedong uprising and in recovering Yedu and Sishui were all to receive additional favor;
translations.idiomatic: Officers and soldiers who had distinguished themselves at the start of the Hedong uprising and in the recovery of Yedu and Sishui were all to be rewarded;

sentences.zh: 亡歿者與追贈。

translations.literal: those deceased were to receive posthumous honors.
translations.idiomatic: the dead were to receive posthumous honors.

sentences.zh: 自東京至鄴都緣路，昨因行幸，有損踐田苗處，據頃畝與放今年租稅。

translations.literal: Along the route from the Eastern Capital to Yedu, wherever crops had been trampled during the recent imperial progress, rent and tax for this year were to be remitted according to acreage.
translations.idiomatic: Along the route from the Eastern Capital to Yedu, wherever the recent imperial progress had damaged crops, this year's rent and tax were remitted in proportion to the acreage affected.

sentences.zh: 鄴都管內，有潛龍時在職者，並與加恩。

translations.literal: Within the jurisdiction of Yedu, all who had held office during the Hidden Dragon period were to receive additional favor.
translations.idiomatic: Within Yedu's jurisdiction, everyone who had served during the emperor's years before enthronement was to be rewarded.

sentences.zh: 耆年八十已上者，版授上佐官。

translations.literal: The elderly aged eighty and above were to receive honorary appointment as senior assistant officials.
translations.idiomatic: Men aged eighty or more were granted honorary senior-assistant rank.

sentences.zh: 天下農器，並許百姓自鑄造。

translations.literal: Throughout the realm, farm implements were all permitted to be cast by the common people themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Farm tools might be cast by private citizens throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 亡命山澤者，招喚歸業；

translations.literal: Those who had fled to mountains and marshes were to be summoned to return to their occupations;
translations.idiomatic: Fugitives hiding in mountains and marshes were to be called home to resume lawful livelihood;

sentences.zh: 百日不出者，復罪如初。

translations.literal: those who did not come forth within a hundred days would again be guilty as before.
translations.idiomatic: any who failed to appear within a hundred days would be punished as before.

sentences.zh: 唐梁國公狄仁傑宜追贈官秩。

translations.literal: Di Renjie, Duke of Liang of Tang, should receive posthumous conferral of rank.
translations.idiomatic: Tang's Duke of Liang, Di Renjie, was to receive posthumous honors.

sentences.zh: 應天福三年已前，敗闕場院官無家業者，並與除放，其人免罪，永不任使。

translations.literal: All depot officials before the third year of Tianfu who had failed in their duties and had no family property were to be discharged and released; the persons themselves were pardoned but never to be employed again.
translations.idiomatic: Depot officials who had failed in office before Tianfu 3 and lacked family property were all discharged and released; they were pardoned but permanently barred from office.

sentences.zh: 私下債負征利及一倍者並放，主持者不在此限。」

translations.literal: Private debts on which interest charged reached one full fold were all remitted; brokers were not included in this provision."
translations.idiomatic: Private debts on which interest had reached the principal were canceled, except where a broker held the debt."

sentences.zh: 丁未，以客省使、將作監丁知浚為內客省使，引進使、鴻臚卿王景崇為客省使，殿中監、判四方館事劉政恩為引進使。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Ding Zhijun, Commissioner of the Guests Bureau and Director of Imperial Construction, was made Commissioner of the Inner Guests Bureau; Wang Jingchong, Introducing Commissioner and Minister of Ceremonial, was made Commissioner of the Guests Bureau; Liu Zhengen, Director of the Palace Service and supervisor of the Four Directions Office, was made Introducing Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Guests Commissioner and Construction Director Ding Zhijun became Inner Guests Commissioner; Introducing Commissioner and Ceremonial Minister Wang Jingchong became Guests Commissioner; and Palace Service Director Liu Zhengen, who supervised the Four Directions Office, became Introducing Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬子，改鄴都皇城南門應天門為乾明門，大明館為都亭驛。

translations.literal: On day renzi, the Yedu imperial city's south gate Yingtian Gate was renamed Qianming Gate, and the Daming Hostel was renamed Duting Post Station.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Yedu's imperial south gate Yingtian was renamed Qianming, and the Daming Hostel became Duting Post Station.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，遣光祿卿張澄、國子博士謝攀使高麗行冊禮。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Zhang Cheng, Minister of Imperial Entertainments, and Xie Pan, Erudite of the National University, were dispatched as envoys to Goryeo to perform investiture rites.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Imperial Entertainments Minister Zhang Cheng and National University erudite Xie Pan were sent to Goryeo to perform investiture ceremonies.

sentences.zh: 九月己未，以兵部侍郎閻至為吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on day jiwei, Yan Zhi, Vice Minister of War, was made Vice Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiwei, War Vice Minister Yan Zhi became Personnel Vice Minister.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，滑州河決，一溉東流，鄉村戶民攜老幼登丘冢，為水所隔，餓死者甚眾。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, the Yellow River breached its banks at Huazhou; a single flood flowed eastward; village households carried the old and young onto mounds and tombs, cut off by the water, and very many died of starvation.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the Yellow River broke through at Huazhou and poured east in a single torrent; villagers fled with the elderly and children to mounds and tombs, but many were trapped by the flood and a great number starved.

sentences.zh: 壬申，忠武建武等軍節度使、守太傅、兼中書令、行蘇州睦州刺史錢元尞進封彭城郡王，遙領廣州清海軍節度使、判婺州軍州事錢元懿為檢校太師。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Qian Yuanyou, military commissioner of the Zhongwu and Jianwu armies, Guardian Grand Mentor and concurrent Grand Councilor and acting prefect of Suzhou and Muzhou, was advanced to Prince of Pengcheng Commandery; Qian Yuanyi, titular military commissioner of the Qinghai army at Guangzhou and administrator of military affairs at Wuzhou, was made Honorary Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Zhongwu-Jianwu commissioner Qian Yuanyou—Guardian Grand Mentor, Grand Councilor, and acting Suzhou-Muzhou prefect—was promoted to Prince of Pengcheng; and titular Qinghai commissioner at Guangzhou Qian Yuanyi, who administered Wuzhou affairs, was made Honorary Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，遣前邢州節度使楊彥詢使於契丹，錫賫甚厚。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Yang Yanxun, former military commissioner of Xingzhou, was dispatched as envoy to the Khitan; gifts bestowed were very generous.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, former Xingzhou commissioner Yang Yanxun was sent as envoy to the Khitan with lavish gifts.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，吐渾遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, the Tuyuhun sent envoys to present tribute at court.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, the Tuyuhun sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 壬午夜，有彗星出於西方，長二丈餘，在房一度，尾跡穿天市垣東行，逾月而滅。

translations.literal: At midnight on day renwu, a comet appeared in the west, more than two zhang in length, situated one degree in the lodge Fang; its tail passed through the eastern wall of the Celestial Market Enclosure and moved eastward, and after more than a month it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: At midnight on renwu, a comet appeared in the west more than two zhang long, one degree within the Fang lodge; its tail crossed the eastern wall of the Celestial Market and swept eastward, vanishing after more than a month.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，兗州上言，水自西來，漂沒秋稼。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Yanzhou memorialized that water came from the west and washed away the autumn crops.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Yanzhou reported that floodwaters from the west had destroyed the autumn harvest.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁亥朔，遣鴻臚少卿魏比等四人，分往滑、濮、鄆、澶視水害苗稼。

translations.literal: On the first day of the tenth month of winter (day dinghai, new moon), Wei Bi, Vice Minister of Ceremonial, and three others were dispatched separately to Hua, Pu, Yan, and Cang to inspect flood damage to crops.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the tenth winter month, Ceremonial Vice Minister Wei Bi and three others were sent separately to Hua, Pu, Yan, and Cang to inspect flood damage to the crops.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔以胡梁度月城為大通軍，浮橋為大通橋。

translations.literal: On day jichou, an edict ordered that the Huliang ferry moon-wall be named the Datong army and the pontoon bridge be named the Datong Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, an edict renamed the Huliang ferry moon-wall the Datong army and its pontoon bridge the Datong Bridge.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔唐梁國公狄仁傑可贈太師。

translations.literal: On day renyin, an edict ordered that Di Renjie, Duke of Liang of Tang, might be posthumously granted Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, an edict posthumously conferred Grand Preceptor on Tang's Duke of Liang, Di Renjie.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁未，鄭王夫人張氏薨。

translations.literal: On dingwei in the eleventh month, Lady Zhang, wife of the Prince of Zheng, died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei in the eleventh month, Lady Zhang, consort of the Prince of Zheng, died.

sentences.zh: 福州王延羲遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: Wang Yanxi of Fuzhou dispatched envoys to present local products.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yanxi of Fuzhou sent envoys bearing local tribute.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，遣太子賓客聶延祚、吏部郎中盧撰持節冊天下兵馬元帥、守尚書令、吳越國王錢元瓘。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Nie Yanzuo, Mentor of the Heir Apparent, and Lu Zhuan, Bureau Director in the Ministry of Personnel, were dispatched with credentials to invest Qian Yuanguan, Commander-in-Chief of All Armies Under Heaven, Acting Director of the Chancellery, and King of Wuyue.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Mentor of the Heir Apparent Nie Yanzuo and Personnel Bureau Director Lu Zhuan were sent with credentials to invest Commander-in-Chief of All Armies Under Heaven Qian Yuanguan, Acting Director of the Chancellery and King of Wuyue.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以御史中丞王松為尚書右丞，中書舍人、史館修撰判館事王易簡為御史中丞，戶部侍郎張昭遠為兵部侍郎，國子祭酒田敏以本官兼戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Vice Censor-in-Chief Wang Song was made Right Assistant Director of the Department of State Affairs; Wang Yijian, Secretariat Drafter and compiler of the Historiography Institute administering its affairs, was made Vice Censor-in-Chief; Vice Minister of Revenue Zhang Zhaoyuan was made Vice Minister of War; and Tian Min, Director of the Imperial University, retained his office and was made concurrent Vice Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Vice Censor-in-Chief Wang Song became Right Assistant Director of the Department of State Affairs; Secretariat Drafter and Historiography Institute compiler Wang Yijian became Vice Censor-in-Chief; Vice Minister of Revenue Zhang Zhaoyuan became Vice Minister of War; and Imperial University Director Tian Min kept his post and was made concurrent Vice Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 辛未，太妃、皇后至自東京。

translations.literal: On xinwei, the Imperial Consort and Empress arrived from the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, the Imperial Consort and Empress returned from the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 壬申，遣給事中李式、考功郎中張鑄持節冊閩國王王延羲。

translations.literal: On renshen, Supervising Secretary Li Shi and Bureau Director in the Ministry of Personnel for merit evaluation Zhang Zhu were dispatched with credentials to invest Wang Yanxi as King of Min.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Supervising Secretary Li Shi and Personnel merit-evaluation Bureau Director Zhang Zhu were sent with credentials to invest Wang Yanxi as King of Min.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，太子少傅致仕王權卒，贈左僕射。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Wang Quan, retired Mentor of the Heir Apparent, died and was posthumously granted Left Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, retired Mentor of the Heir Apparent Wang Quan died and was posthumously made Left Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，襄州安從進舉兵叛，以西京留守高行周為南面行營都部署，率兵討之，以前同州節度使宋彥筠為副，以宣徽南院使張從恩監護焉。

translations.literal: On dingchou, An Congjin of Xiangzhou raised troops in rebellion; Gao Xingzhou, defender of the Western Capital, was made overall commander of the southern field camp to lead troops against him, with Song Yanyun, former military commissioner of Tongzhou, as deputy and Zhang Congen, Southern Chancellor of the Palace Secretariat, as overseer.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, An Congjin of Xiangzhou rebelled and took up arms. Western Capital defender Gao Xingzhou was made southern field commander to lead troops against him, with former Tongzhou commissioner Song Yanyun as deputy and Southern Palace Secretariat Chancellor Zhang Congen as overseer.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙戌朔，以東京留守、開封尹、鄭王重貴為廣晉尹，進封齊王；

translations.literal: On the first day of the twelfth month (day bingxu, new moon), Chonggui, defender of the Eastern Capital, prefect of Kaifeng, and Prince of Zheng, was made prefect of Guangjin and advanced to Prince of Qi;
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the twelfth month, Eastern Capital defender Chonggui, Kaifeng prefect and Prince of Zheng, was made Guangjin prefect and promoted to Prince of Qi;

sentences.zh: 以鄴都留守、廣晉尹李德充為開封尹，充東京留守。

translations.literal: Li Dechong, defender of Yedu and prefect of Guangjin, was made prefect of Kaifeng and appointed defender of the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Yedu defender and Guangjin prefect Li Dechong became Kaifeng prefect and Eastern Capital defender.

sentences.zh: 南面軍前奏，十一月二十七日，武德使焦繼勛、先鋒都指揮使郭金海等於唐州南遇安從進賊軍一萬餘人，大破之，

translations.literal: The southern army front memorialized that on the twenty-seventh day of the eleventh month, Jiao Jixun, Commissioner of Martial Virtue, Guo Jinhai, vanguard commander, and others south of Tangzhou encountered more than ten thousand troops of the rebel An Congjin's army and routed them greatly,
translations.idiomatic: The southern front reported that on the twenty-seventh of the eleventh month, Martial Virtue commissioner Jiao Jixun, vanguard commander Guo Jinhai, and others met more than ten thousand men of rebel An Congjin's force south of Tangzhou and inflicted a crushing defeat,

sentences.zh: 〈（《宋史·陳思讓傳》：思讓為先鋒右廂都監，從武德焦繼勛領兵進討，遇從進之師於唐州花山下，急擊，大破之。）〉

translations.literal: (From the 《Biography of Chen Sirang》 in the 《History of Song》: Sirang was vanguard right-wing supervisor; following Jiao Jixun of Martial Virtue he led troops on the punitive campaign, encountered Congjin's army below Flower Mountain at Tangzhou, attacked swiftly, and routed them greatly.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (《History of Song》, 《Biography of Chen Sirang》: Sirang served as right-wing vanguard supervisor; marching with Jiao Jixun of Martial Virtue against the rebels, he met Congjin's army below Flower Mountain at Tangzhou, attacked at once, and won a great victory.)〉

sentences.zh: 生擒衙內都指揮使安宏義，獲山南東道之印，其安從進單騎奔逸。

translations.literal: they captured alive An Hongyi, commander of the inner headquarters, seized the seal of the Shannan East Circuit, and An Congjin himself fled alone on horseback.
translations.idiomatic: They took An Hongyi, commander of the inner headquarters, alive, captured the seal of the Shannan East Circuit, and An Congjin himself fled alone on horseback.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔襄州行營都部署高行周權知襄州軍州事。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, an edict ordered Gao Xingzhou, overall commander of the mobile camp at Xiangzhou, to act as administrator of Xiangzhou military and civil affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, an edict placed Gao Xingzhou, commander of the Xiangzhou field headquarters, in temporary charge of Xiangzhou military and civil affairs.

sentences.zh: 是日，鎮州節度使安重榮稱兵向闕，以侍衛親軍馬步軍都指揮使杜重威為北面行營招討使，率兵擊之，以邢州節度使馬全節為副，以前貝州節度使王周為馬步軍都虞候。

translations.literal: That same day, An Chongrong, military commissioner of Zhenzhou, raised troops and marched toward the capital; Du Chongwei, commander of the Palace Guard horse and foot armies, was made northern campaign commander to lead troops against him; Ma Quanjie, military commissioner of Xingzhou, was made deputy; Wang Zhou, former military commissioner of Beizhou, was made chief adjutant of the horse and foot armies.
translations.idiomatic: That same day, Zhenzhou commissioner An Chongrong took up arms and marched on the capital; Palace Guard commander Du Chongwei was appointed northern campaign commander to lead the attack, with Xingzhou commissioner Ma Quanjie as his deputy and former Beizhou commissioner Wang Zhou as chief adjutant.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，武德使焦繼勛奏，安從進遣弟從貴領兵千人，取接均州刺史蔡行遇，尋領所部兵掩殺賊軍七百餘人，生擒安從貴，截其雙腕，卻放入城。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Jiao Jixun, Commissioner of Martial Virtue, memorialized that An Congjin had sent his younger brother Conggui to lead a thousand troops to link up with Cai Xingyu, prefect of Junzhou; shortly afterward he led his own troops in a surprise attack and killed more than seven hundred rebel troops, captured Conggui alive, cut off both his wrists, and sent him back into the city.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Martial Virtue commissioner Jiao Jixun reported that An Congjin had sent his brother Conggui with a thousand men to join Junzhou prefect Cai Xingyu; Jiao then ambushed the rebels, killing more than seven hundred, capturing Conggui alive, severing both his wrists, and sending him back into the city.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以皇子重睿為銀青光祿大夫、檢校尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, the prince Chongrui was made Silver-Gleam Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and Honorary Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Prince Chongrui was appointed Silver-Gleam Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and Honorary Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 己亥，北面軍前奏，十三日未時，於宗城縣西南大破鎮州賊軍，殺一萬五千人，餘黨走保宗城縣。

translations.literal: On day jihai, the northern army front memorialized that at the wei hour on the thirteenth day, southwest of Zongcheng County, they routed the Zhenzhou rebel army greatly, killing fifteen thousand men; the remaining band fled to hold Zongcheng County.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, the northern front reported that at the wei hour on the thirteenth, southwest of Zongcheng County, they had routed the Zhenzhou rebels, killing fifteen thousand; the survivors fled into Zongcheng County.

sentences.zh: 是夜三更，破縣城，前深州刺史史虔武自縛歸降。

translations.literal: At the third watch that night, the county seat was taken; Shi Qianwu, former prefect of Shenzhou, bound himself and came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: At the third watch that night the county seat fell; former Shenzhou prefect Shi Qianwu bound himself and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 獲馬三千匹，絹三萬餘匹，餘物稱是。

translations.literal: They seized three thousand horses, more than thirty thousand bolts of silk, and other goods in proportion.
translations.idiomatic: They captured three thousand horses, more than thirty thousand bolts of silk, and comparable quantities of other goods.

sentences.zh: 安重榮脫身遁走。

translations.literal: An Chongrong escaped and fled.
translations.idiomatic: An Chongrong slipped away and fled.

sentences.zh: 是日，百官稱賀。

translations.literal: That day, the hundred officials offered congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: That day the officials offered congratulations.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，削奪安從進、安重榮在身官爵。

translations.literal: On day guimao, the offices and ranks held by An Congjin and An Chongrong were stripped.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, An Congjin and An Chongrong were stripped of their offices and titles.

sentences.zh: 右金吾上將軍萇從簡卒，廢朝，贈太師。

translations.literal: Chang Congjian, General of the Right Golden Crow Guard, died; court was suspended; he was posthumously granted Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: Right Golden Crow general Chang Congjian died; court mourning was ordered, and he was posthumously made Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，天下兵馬都元帥、守尚書令、吳越國王錢元瓘薨，廢朝三日，謚曰文穆。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Qian Yuanguan, Commander-in-Chief of All Armies, Guardian Minister of State, and King of Wuyue, died; court was suspended for three days; his posthumous title was Wenmu.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Commander-in-Chief Qian Yuanguan, Guardian Minister of State and King of Wuyue, died; court mourning lasted three days, and he was given the posthumous title Wenmu.

sentences.zh: 是日，帝習射於後苑，諸軍都指揮使已上悉預焉，賜物有差。

translations.literal: That day, the emperor practiced archery in the rear garden; all army commanders and above participated; gifts were bestowed in varying measure.
translations.idiomatic: That day the emperor practiced archery in the rear garden; every army commander and above took part, and gifts were distributed according to rank.

sentences.zh: 丁未，南面行營都部署高行周奏，今月十三日，部領大軍至襄州城下，相次降賊軍二千人。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Gao Xingzhou, overall commander of the southern field army, memorialized that on the thirteenth day of this month he had led the main army to below the walls of Xiangzhou, and rebel troops surrendered in succession, two thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, southern field commander Gao Xingzhou reported that on the thirteenth of this month he had led the main army to Xiangzhou, where two thousand rebel troops surrendered in succession.

sentences.zh: 其降兵馬軍詔以「彰聖」為號，步軍以「歸順」為號。

translations.literal: The surrendered cavalry were by edict given the designation "Zhangsheng"; the infantry were given the designation "Guishun".
translations.idiomatic: The surrendered cavalry were designated "Zhangsheng" by edict, and the infantry "Guishun".

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以權知吳越國事錢宏佐為起復鎮軍大將軍、檢校太師、兼中書令、杭州越州大都督、鎮海鎮東等軍節度使，封吳越國王。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Qian Hongzuo, acting administrator of Wuyue state affairs, was made Grand General of the Pacifying Army upon resumption of mourning, Honorary Grand Preceptor, concurrent Grand Councilor, Grand Protector of Hangzhou and Yuezhou, military commissioner of the Zhenhai and Zhendong armies, and enfeoffed as King of Wuyue.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, acting Wuyue administrator Qian Hongzuo was recalled from mourning as Grand General of the Pacifying Army, Honorary Grand Preceptor, Grand Councilor, Grand Protector of Hangzhou and Yuezhou, commissioner of the Zhenhai and Zhendong armies, and enfeoffed as King of Wuyue.

sentences.zh: 壬子，杜重威部領大軍至鎮州城下。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Du Chongwei led the main army to below the walls of Zhenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Du Chongwei led the main army to Zhenzhou.

sentences.zh: 天福七年春正月丙辰朔，不受朝賀，用兵故也。

translations.literal: In spring, on the first day of the first month of the seventh year of Tianfu (day bingchen, new moon), court congratulations were not accepted, because of military operations.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the first month of spring in Tianfu 7, the emperor declined court congratulations because troops were in the field.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以前將作監李鍇為少府監。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Li Kai, former Director of Imperial Construction, was made Director of the Palace Workshops.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, former Construction Director Li Kai became Palace Workshops director.

sentences.zh: 北面招討使杜重威奏，今月二日收復鎮州，斬安重榮，傳首闕下。

translations.literal: Du Chongwei, northern campaign commander, memorialized that on the second day of this month Zhenzhou had been recovered, An Chongrong was beheaded, and his head was sent to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Northern campaign commander Du Chongwei reported that on the second of this month Zhenzhou had been retaken, An Chongrong beheaded, and his head sent to the capital.

sentences.zh: 帝御乾明樓，宣露布訖，大理卿受馘，付市徇之，百官稱賀。

translations.literal: The emperor ascended the Qianming Tower, proclaimed the victory bulletin, and when it was finished the Minister of Punishments received the severed head and handed it to the market for public display; the hundred officials offered congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor mounted the Qianming Tower and proclaimed the victory bulletin; when the rites were done, the Minister of Punishments received the severed head and had it displayed in the market, and the officials offered congratulations.

sentences.zh: 曲赦廣晉府禁囚。

translations.literal: A partial amnesty was granted to prisoners held in the Guangjin prefecture jail.
translations.idiomatic: A partial amnesty was proclaimed for prisoners in the Guangjin jail.

sentences.zh: 〈（《遼史》云：戊辰，晉函安重榮首來獻，上數欲親討重榮，至是乃止。）〉

translations.literal: (The 《Liao History》 states: On day wuchen, Jin sent An Chongrong's head in a box as tribute; the emperor had several times wished to campaign against Chongrong in person, and only then stopped.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (《Liao History》: On wuchen, Later Jin presented An Chongrong's head in a box; the Khitan emperor had repeatedly intended to campaign against Chongrong in person, and only then abandoned the plan.)〉

sentences.zh: 辛酉，追贈皇弟三人：故沂州馬步軍都指揮使、贈太傅德再贈太尉，追封福王；

translations.literal: On day xinyou, three imperial younger brothers were posthumously honored: De, former commander of horse and foot armies at Yizhou and posthumously Grand Mentor, was again granted Grand Marshal and enfeoffed posthumously as Prince of Fu;
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, three imperial younger brothers received posthumous honors: De, former Yizhou horse-and-foot commander and already Grand Mentor, was raised to Grand Marshal and posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Fu;

sentences.zh: 故檢校太子賓客、贈太傅殷再贈太尉，追封通王；

translations.literal: Yin, former Honorary Tutor to the Heir Apparent and posthumously Grand Mentor, was again granted Grand Marshal and enfeoffed posthumously as Prince of Tong;
translations.idiomatic: Yin, former Honorary Heir Apparent Tutor and Grand Mentor, was raised to Grand Marshal and posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Tong;

sentences.zh: 故彰聖右第三軍都指揮使長州刺史、贈大傅威再贈太尉，追封廣王。

translations.literal: Wei, former commander of the third right army of Zhangsheng and prefect of Changzhou and posthumously Grand Mentor, was again granted Grand Marshal and enfeoffed posthumously as Prince of Guang.
translations.idiomatic: Wei, former Zhangsheng third-right-army commander and Changzhou prefect, already Grand Mentor, was raised to Grand Marshal and posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Guang.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，追贈皇子五人：故右衛將軍、贈太保重英再贈太傅，追封虢王；

translations.literal: On day renxu, five imperial sons were posthumously honored: Chongying, former General of the Right Guard and posthumously Grand Marshal, was again granted Grand Mentor and enfeoffed posthumously as Prince of Guo;
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, five imperial sons received posthumous honors: Chongying, former Right Guard general and Grand Marshal, was raised to Grand Mentor and posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Guo;

sentences.zh: 故權東京留守、河南尹、贈太傅重乂再贈太尉，追封壽王；

translations.literal: Chongyi, former acting defender of the Eastern Capital and prefect of Henan and posthumously Grand Mentor, was again granted Grand Marshal and enfeoffed posthumously as Prince of Shou;
translations.idiomatic: Chongyi, former acting Eastern Capital defender and Henan prefect, already Grand Mentor, was raised to Grand Marshal and posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Shou;

sentences.zh: 故皇城副使、贈太保重裔再贈太傅，追封郯王；

translations.literal: Chongyi, former vice commissioner of the Imperial City and posthumously Grand Marshal, was again granted Grand Mentor and enfeoffed posthumously as Prince of Tan;
translations.idiomatic: Chongyi, former Imperial City vice commissioner and Grand Marshal, was raised to Grand Mentor and posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Tan;

sentences.zh: 故河陽節度使、贈太尉重信再贈太師，追封沂王；

translations.literal: Chongxin, former military commissioner of Heyang and posthumously Grand Marshal, was again granted Grand Preceptor and enfeoffed posthumously as Prince of Yi;
translations.idiomatic: Chongxin, former Heyang commissioner and Grand Marshal, was raised to Grand Preceptor and posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Yi;

sentences.zh: 故左金吾衛將軍、贈太保重進再贈太傅，追封夔王。

translations.literal: Chongjin, former General of the Left Golden Crow Guard and posthumously Grand Marshal, was again granted Grand Mentor and enfeoffed posthumously as Prince of Kui.
translations.idiomatic: Chongjin, former Left Golden Crow general and Grand Marshal, was raised to Grand Mentor and posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Kui.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，改鎮州為恒州，成德軍為順國軍。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Zhenzhou was renamed Hengzhou, and the Chengde army was renamed the Shunguo army.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Zhenzhou was renamed Hengzhou and the Chengde army redesignated Shunguo.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以門下侍郎、平章事、監修國史趙瑩為侍中；

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Zhao Ying, Vice Minister of the Secretariat, Grand Councilor, and supervisor of the compilation of the national history, was made Palace Vice Minister;
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Secretariat Vice Minister, Grand Councilor, and national-history supervisor Zhao Ying became Palace Vice Minister;

sentences.zh: 青州節度使楊光遠加食邑，改賜功臣名號；

translations.literal: Yang Guangyuan, military commissioner of Qingzhou, received an increase in fief income and a change in the bestowed honorary epithet of merit;
translations.idiomatic: Qingzhou commissioner Yang Guangyuan received an increased fief and a new merit epithet;

sentences.zh: 兗州節度使桑維翰加檢校太保；

translations.literal: Sang Weihan, military commissioner of Yanzhou, was made Honorary Grand Guardian;
translations.idiomatic: Yanzhou commissioner Sang Weihan was made Honorary Grand Guardian;

sentences.zh: 河東節度使劉知遠加兼侍中；

translations.literal: Liu Zhiyuan, military commissioner of Hedong, was additionally made Vice Grand Councilor;
translations.idiomatic: Hedong commissioner Liu Zhiyuan was also made Vice Grand Councilor;

sentences.zh: 以鄆州節度使、北面行營招討使、侍衛親軍都指揮使杜重威為恒州順國軍節度使，加兼侍中；

translations.literal: Du Chongwei, military commissioner of Yanzhou, northern campaign commander, and commander of the Palace Guard, was made military commissioner of the Shunguo army at Hengzhou and additionally made Vice Grand Councilor;
translations.idiomatic: Yanzhou commissioner, northern campaign commander, and Palace Guard commander Du Chongwei became Shunguo commissioner at Hengzhou and was also made Vice Grand Councilor;

sentences.zh: 皇子廣晉尹兼功德使、齊王重貴加兼侍中；

translations.literal: Chonggui, prince, prefect of Guangjin and concurrently Commissioner of Meritorious Works and Prince of Qi, was additionally made Vice Grand Councilor;
translations.idiomatic: Prince Chonggui of Qi, Guangjin prefect and Commissioner of Meritorious Works, was also made Vice Grand Councilor;

sentences.zh: 秦州節度使侯益加特進，增食邑。

translations.literal: Hou Yi, military commissioner of Qinzhou, was granted Special Advancement and an increase in fief income.
translations.idiomatic: Qinzhou commissioner Hou Yi received Special Advancement and an enlarged fief.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以判四方館事孟承誨為太府卿充職。

translations.literal: On the dingmao day, Meng Chenghui, commissioner of the Four Directions Reception Office, was made Director of the Palace Storehouse with charge of the office.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Meng Chenghui, commissioner of the Four Directions Reception Office, was appointed Director of the Palace Storehouse.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以滄州節度使安叔千為邢州節度使，以北面行營副招討使、邢州節度使馬全節為定州節度使，以定州節度使王庭胤為滄州節度使，以前邢州節度使楊彥詢為華州節度使。

translations.literal: On the wuchen day, An Shuqian, military commissioner of Cangzhou, was made military commissioner of Xingzhou; Ma Quanjie, deputy northern campaign pacification commissioner and military commissioner of Xingzhou, was made military commissioner of Dingzhou; Wang Tingyin, military commissioner of Dingzhou, was made military commissioner of Cangzhou; Yang Yanxun, former military commissioner of Xingzhou, was made military commissioner of Huazhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Cangzhou commissioner An Shuqian became Xingzhou commissioner; Xingzhou commissioner and deputy northern campaign pacification commissioner Ma Quanjie became Dingzhou commissioner; Dingzhou commissioner Wang Tingyin became Cangzhou commissioner; and former Xingzhou commissioner Yang Yanxun became Huazhou commissioner.

sentences.zh: 恒州立功將校王溫以降等第除郡。

translations.literal: Wang Wen, an officer of Hengzhou who had earned merit, was given a prefectural appointment at a reduced rank grade.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Wen, a meritorious officer of Hengzhou, received a prefectural post at a demoted rank.

sentences.zh: 庚午，契丹遣使來聘。

translations.literal: On the gengwu day, the Khitan sent envoys on a friendly visit.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Khitan envoys arrived on a friendly mission.

sentences.zh: 是日上元節，六街諸寺燃燈，禦乾明門觀之，夜半還宮。

translations.literal: That day was the Lantern Festival; lanterns were lit at temples throughout the Six Streets; the emperor went to Qianming Gate to view them and returned to the palace at midnight.
translations.idiomatic: That day was the Lantern Festival. Lanterns blazed at temples throughout the Six Streets, and the emperor watched from Qianming Gate before returning to the palace at midnight.

sentences.zh: 壬申，延州節度使丁審琦加爵邑，鄧州節度使安審徽加檢校太傅，陜州節度使石赟加檢校太傅。

translations.literal: On the renshen day, Ding Shenqi, military commissioner of Yanzhou, received ennoblement and an increase in fief income; An Shenhui, military commissioner of Dengzhou, was made Honorary Grand Mentor; Shi Yun, military commissioner of Shaanzhou, was made Honorary Grand Mentor.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Yanzhou commissioner Ding Shenqi received ennoblement and an enlarged fief; Dengzhou commissioner An Shenhui was made Honorary Grand Mentor; and Shaanzhou commissioner Shi Yun was made Honorary Grand Mentor.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，契丹遣使來聘。

translations.literal: On the yihai day, the Khitan sent envoys on a friendly visit.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Khitan envoys arrived on a friendly mission.

sentences.zh: 河陽節度使兼侍衛馬步軍都虞候景延廣加檢校太尉，改鄆州節度使，典軍如故。

translations.literal: Jing Yanguang, military commissioner of Heyang and chief adjutant of the Palace Guard horse and foot armies, was made Honorary Grand Marshal, transferred to military commissioner of Yanzhou, and retained command of the army as before.
translations.idiomatic: Heyang commissioner and Palace Guard chief adjutant Jing Yanguang was made Honorary Grand Marshal, transferred to Yanzhou commissioner, and kept his army command.

sentences.zh: 以前貝州節度使、北面行營馬步軍都虞候王周為河陽節度使，加檢校太保。

translations.literal: Wang Zhou, former military commissioner of Beizhou and chief adjutant of the northern campaign horse and foot armies, was made military commissioner of Heyang and granted Honorary Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: Former Beizhou commissioner and northern campaign chief adjutant Wang Zhou became Heyang commissioner and was made Honorary Grand Guardian.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以刑部侍郎竇貞固為門下侍郎，以禮部郎中邊歸讜為比部郎中、知制誥。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day, Dou Zhengu, Vice Minister of Punishments, was made Vice Minister of the Secretariat; Bian Guidan, Bureau Director in the Ministry of Rites, was made Bureau Director of Penalties and drafter of rescripts.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Vice Minister of Punishments Dou Zhengu became Secretariat Vice Minister, and Rites Bureau Director Bian Guidan became Penalties Bureau Director and drafter of rescripts.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以河陽節度使王周為涇州節度使，以恒州節度副使王欽祚為殿中監。

translations.literal: On the renwu day, Wang Zhou, military commissioner of Heyang, was made military commissioner of Jingzhou; Wang Qinzuo, deputy military commissioner of Hengzhou, was made Director of Palace Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Heyang commissioner Wang Zhou became Jingzhou commissioner, and Hengzhou deputy commissioner Wang Qinzuo became Director of Palace Affairs.

sentences.zh: 二月丁亥，皇妹清平公主進封衛國長公主。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the dinghai day, the emperor's younger sister, Princess Qingping, was promoted and enfeoffed as Princess of Weiguo.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai in the second month, the emperor's younger sister Princess Qingping was promoted to Princess of Weiguo.

sentences.zh: 契丹遣使來聘。

translations.literal: The Khitan sent envoys on a friendly visit.
translations.idiomatic: Khitan envoys arrived on a friendly mission.

sentences.zh: 己丑，宴於武德殿，新恒州節度使杜重威已下、諸軍副兵馬使已上悉預焉，賜物有差。

translations.literal: On the jichou day, a banquet was held in the Wude Hall; Du Chongwei, the new military commissioner of Hengzhou, and all below him, together with deputy military commissioners of the various armies and above, all attended; gifts were graded by rank.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou the court feasted in the Wude Hall. Du Chongwei, the new Hengzhou commissioner, and every officer down to deputy military commissioners attended, and gifts were graded by rank.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以曹州防禦使何建為延州留後。

translations.literal: On the jihai day, He Jian, defense commissioner of Caozhou, was made acting commissioner of Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Caozhou defense commissioner He Jian was appointed acting Yanzhou commissioner.

sentences.zh: 涇州奏，差押牙陳延暉賫敕書往西涼府，本府都指揮使等請以陳延暉為節度使。

translations.literal: Jingzhou memorialized that escort commander Chen Yanhui had been dispatched bearing an edict to Xiliang Prefecture, and the prefecture's overall commander and others requested that Chen Yanhui be made military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Jingzhou reported that escort commander Chen Yanhui had been sent with an edict to Xiliang Prefecture, where the overall commander and others asked that Chen Yanhui be made military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，宰臣李崧丁母憂，起復舊任。

translations.literal: On the xinchou day, Grand Councilor Li Song entered mourning for his mother and was recalled from mourning to his former post.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Grand Councilor Li Song was mourning his mother but was recalled to his former post.

sentences.zh: 延州蕃寇作亂，同州、鄜州各起牙兵討平之。

translations.literal: Tribal bandits rebelled at Yanzhou; Tongzhou and Fuzhou each raised garrison troops to suppress and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: Tribal raiders rose in revolt at Yanzhou, and Tongzhou and Fuzhou each mobilized garrison troops to put them down.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔：「鄧、唐、隨、郢諸州，多有曠土，宜令人戶取便開耕，與免五年差稅。」

translations.literal: On the bingwu day, an edict stated: "In the prefectures of Deng, Tang, Sui, and E there is much idle land; people and households should be permitted to open and cultivate it as they find convenient, and labor and tax levies should be exempted for five years."
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, an edict declared: "Deng, Tang, Sui, and E have much unused land. Households may reclaim it as they choose, with labor and tax levies waived for five years."

sentences.zh: 三月己未，兵部尚書韓惲卒。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the jiwei day, Han Yun, Minister of War, died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei in the third month, Minister of War Han Yun died.

sentences.zh: 庚申，遣前齊州防禦使宋光鄴、翰林茶酒使張言使於契丹。

translations.literal: On the gengshen day, Song Guangye, former defense commissioner of Qizhou, and Zhang Yan, Hanlin tea and wine commissioner, were dispatched as envoys to the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, former Qizhou defense commissioner Song Guangye and Hanlin tea and wine commissioner Zhang Yan were sent as envoys to the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，分命朝臣諸寺觀禱雨。

translations.literal: On the renxu day, court officials were separately ordered to temples and monasteries to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, court officials were dispatched separately to temples and monasteries to pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，皇后為妹契丹樞密使趙延壽妻燕國長公主卒於幽州，舉哀於外次。

translations.literal: On the bingyin day, the empress's younger sister, Princess of Yan and wife of the Khitan Commissioner of Military Affairs Zhao Yanshou, died at Youzhou; mourning was observed at the outer pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, the empress's younger sister, Princess of Yan and wife of Khitan Commissioner of Military Affairs Zhao Yanshou, died at Youzhou, and the court observed mourning at the outer pavilion.

sentences.zh: 辛未，滑州節度使、駙馬都尉史匡翰卒，輟朝，贈太保。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day, Shi Kuanghan, military commissioner of Huazhou and imperial son-in-law, died; court audiences were suspended, and he was posthumously granted Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Huazhou commissioner and imperial son-in-law Shi Kuanghan died. Court audiences were suspended, and he was posthumously made Grand Guardian.

sentences.zh: 詔唐州湖陽縣蓼山神祠宜賜號為「蓼山顯順之神」。

translations.literal: An edict stated that the shrine to the spirit of Mount Liao at Hushan in Huyang County, Tang Prefecture, should be granted the title "Spirit of Manifest Compliance of Mount Liao."
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted the Hushan shrine in Huyang County, Tang Prefecture, the title "Spirit of Manifest Compliance of Mount Liao."

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以晉昌軍節度使安審琦為河中節度使，以前亳州防禦使王令溫為貝州節度使。

translations.literal: On the yihai day, An Shenqi, military commissioner of the Jinchang army, was made military commissioner of Hezhong; Wang Lingwen, former defense commissioner of Bozhou, was made military commissioner of Beizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Jinchang commissioner An Shenqi became Hezhong commissioner, and former Bozhou defense commissioner Wang Lingwen became Beizhou commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙子，賜宰臣李崧白藤肩輿，以起復故也。

translations.literal: On the bingzi day, Grand Councilor Li Song was granted a white rattan shoulder-carried sedan chair because of his recall from mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Grand Councilor Li Song received a white rattan sedan chair in recognition of his recall from mourning.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以晉州節度使皇甫遇為河陽節度使，以壽州節度使兼侍衛步馬軍指揮使李守貞為滑州節度使，以夔州節度使兼侍衛步軍都指揮使郭謹為相州節度使，皆典軍如故。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day, Huangfu Yu, military commissioner of Jinzhou, was made military commissioner of Heyang; Li Shouzhen, military commissioner of Shouzhou and commander of the Palace Guard infantry and cavalry, was made military commissioner of Huazhou; Guo Jin, military commissioner of Kuizhou and commander of the Palace Guard infantry, was made military commissioner of Xiangzhou; all retained command of the army as before.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Jinzhou commissioner Huangfu Yu became Heyang commissioner; Shouzhou commissioner and Palace Guard infantry-and-cavalry commander Li Shouzhen became Huazhou commissioner; Kuizhou commissioner and Palace Guard infantry commander Guo Jin became Xiangzhou commissioner; all kept their army commands.

sentences.zh: 宰臣於寺觀禱雨。

translations.literal: The grand councilors prayed for rain at temples and monasteries.
translations.idiomatic: The grand councilors prayed for rain at temples and monasteries.

sentences.zh: 閏月丙戌，以兵部郎中司徒詡為右諫議大夫。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the bingxu day, Si Tuyi, Bureau Director in the Ministry of War, was made Right Remonstrance Censor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu in the intercalary month, War Bureau Director Si Tuyi became Right Remonstrance Censor.

sentences.zh: 戊子，兗州節度使桑維翰加特進，封開國公。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day, Sang Weihan, military commissioner of Yanzhou, was granted Special Advancement and enfeoffed Duke with fief.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Yanzhou commissioner Sang Weihan received Special Advancement and was enfeoffed Duke with fief.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以延州留後何建為延州節度使，以引進使兼殿中監劉政恩為太子詹事。

translations.literal: On the gengyin day, He Jian, acting commissioner of Yanzhou, was made military commissioner of Yanzhou; Liu Zheng'en, reception commissioner and Director of Palace Affairs, was made Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, acting Yanzhou commissioner He Jian became Yanzhou military commissioner, and reception commissioner and Director of Palace Affairs Liu Zheng'en became Tutor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，宋州節度使安彥威奏，修滑州黃河功畢。

translations.literal: On the renchen day, An Yanwei, military commissioner of Songzhou, memorialized that repair work on the Yellow River at Huazhou was complete.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Songzhou commissioner An Yanwei reported that Yellow River repair work at Huazhou was finished.

sentences.zh: 詔於河決之地建碑立廟。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that at the site of the river breach a stele and a temple be erected.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered a stele and temple erected at the site of the river breach.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以鄜州節度使周密為晉州節度使，以左羽林統軍符彥卿為鄜州節度使。

translations.literal: On the bingshen day, Zhou Mi, military commissioner of Fuzhou, was made military commissioner of Jinzhou; Fu Yanqing, commander of the Left Feathered Forest Army, was made military commissioner of Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Fuzhou commissioner Zhou Mi became Jinzhou commissioner, and Left Feathered Forest commander Fu Yanqing became Fuzhou commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔百官五日一度起居，日輪定兩員，具所見以封事奏聞。

translations.literal: On the renyin day, an edict ordered that officials of the hundred ranks attend imperial audience once every five days, with two fixed by daily rotation, and submit sealed memorials reporting what they had observed.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, an edict required officials to attend imperial audience every five days, with two on rotation each day, and to submit sealed memorials on what they had observed.

sentences.zh: 詔改鄴都宣明門為朱鳳門；

translations.literal: An edict changed the Xuandu Xuaming Gate to Zhufeng Gate;
translations.idiomatic: An edict renamed the Xuandu Xuaming Gate Zhufeng Gate;

sentences.zh: 武德殿為視政殿，文思殿為崇德殿，畫堂為天清殿，寢殿為乾福殿，其門悉從殿名；

translations.literal: the Wude Hall to Shizheng Hall, the Wensi Hall to Chongde Hall, the Huatang to Tianqing Hall, the sleeping hall to Qianfu Hall, and all their gates were named after the halls;
translations.idiomatic: the Wude Hall to Shizheng Hall, the Wensi Hall to Chongde Hall, the Painted Hall to Tianqing Hall, and the sleeping hall to Qianfu Hall, with each gate renamed to match its hall;

sentences.zh: 皇城南門為乾明門，北門為元德門，東門為萬春門，西門為千秋門；

translations.literal: the imperial city's south gate to Qianming Gate, the north gate to Yuande Gate, the east gate to Wanchun Gate, and the west gate to Qianqiu Gate;
translations.idiomatic: the imperial city south gate to Qianming Gate, the north gate to Yuande Gate, the east gate to Wanchun Gate, and the west gate to Qianqiu Gate;

sentences.zh: 羅城南磚門為廣運門，觀音門為金明門，橙槽門為清景門，寇氏門為永芳門，朝臣門為景風門；

translations.literal: the outer city's south brick gate to Guangyun Gate, the Guanyin Gate to Jinming Gate, the Chengcao Gate to Qingjing Gate, the Koushi Gate to Yongfang Gate, and the officials' gate to Jingfeng Gate;
translations.idiomatic: the outer city south brick gate to Guangyun Gate, the Guanyin Gate to Jinming Gate, the Chengcao Gate to Qingjing Gate, the Koushi Gate to Yongfang Gate, and the officials' gate to Jingfeng Gate;

sentences.zh: 大城南門為昭明門，觀音門為廣義門，北河門為靜安門，魏縣門為應福門，寇氏門為迎春門，朝城門為興仁門，上斗門為延清門，下斗門為通遠門。

translations.literal: the great city's south gate to Zhaoming Gate, the Guanyin Gate to Guangyi Gate, the north river gate to Jing'an Gate, the Wei County Gate to Yingfu Gate, the Koushi Gate to Yingchun Gate, the Chaocheng Gate to Xingren Gate, the upper dou gate to Yanqing Gate, and the lower dou gate to Tongyuan Gate.
translations.idiomatic: the great city south gate to Zhaoming Gate, the Guanyin Gate to Guangyi Gate, the north river gate to Jing'an Gate, the Wei County Gate to Yingfu Gate, the Koushi Gate to Yingchun Gate, the Chaocheng Gate to Xingren Gate, the upper dou gate to Yanqing Gate, and the lower dou gate to Tongyuan Gate.

sentences.zh: 戊申，宋州節度使安彥威封邠國公，賞修河之勞也。

translations.literal: On the wushen day, An Yanwei, military commissioner of Songzhou, was enfeoffed Duke of Bin, in reward for his labor on river repair.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Songzhou commissioner An Yanwei was enfeoffed Duke of Bin as reward for his river-repair work.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，涇州節度使王周奏，前節度使張彥澤在任日不法事二十六條，已改正停廢。

translations.literal: On the guichou day, Wang Zhou, military commissioner of Jingzhou, memorialized that during the tenure of the former military commissioner Zhang Yanze there had been twenty-six unlawful acts, all of which had now been corrected and abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Jingzhou commissioner Wang Zhou reported twenty-six illegal practices from former commissioner Zhang Yanze's tenure, all of which he had now corrected and abolished.

sentences.zh: 詔褒之。

translations.literal: An edict commended him.
translations.idiomatic: An edict praised him.

sentences.zh: 是春，鄴都、鳳翔、兗、陜、汝、恒、陳等州旱，鄆、曹、澶、博、相、洺諸州蝗。

translations.literal: That spring, Yedu, Fengxiang, Yan, Shaan, Ru, Heng, and Chen suffered drought; Yan, Cao, Dan, Bo, Xiang, and Ming suffered locusts.
translations.idiomatic: That spring drought struck Yedu, Fengxiang, Yan, Shaan, Ru, Heng, and Chen, while locusts ravaged Yan, Cao, Dan, Bo, Xiang, and Ming.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲寅朔，避正殿不視朝，日蝕故也。

translations.literal: In summer, on the new moon of the fourth month, day jiayin, the emperor avoided the main hall and did not hold court, because of a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: At the new moon of the fourth month of summer, the emperor avoided the main hall and suspended court because of a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 是日，太陽不虧，百官上表稱賀。

translations.literal: That day the sun was not eclipsed, and officials of the hundred ranks submitted memorials of congratulation.
translations.idiomatic: That day the sun was not eclipsed, and officials submitted congratulatory memorials.

sentences.zh: 詔沿河藩郡節度使、刺史並兼管內河堤使。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that military commissioners and prefects of frontier prefectures along the river all concurrently serve as commissioners of river dikes within their jurisdictions.
translations.idiomatic: An edict made riverine frontier commissioners and prefects concurrent commissioners of river dikes within their circuits.

sentences.zh: 己未，右諫議大夫鄭受益兩疏論張彥澤在涇州之日，違法虐民，支解掌書記張式、部曲楊洪等，請下所司，明申其罪。

translations.literal: On the jiwei day, Zheng Shouyi, Right Remonstrance Censor, submitted two memorials concerning Zhang Yanze's days at Jingzhou, when he violated the law and tyrannized the people, dismembered secretary Zhang Shi and retainer Yang Hong and others, and requested that the matter be referred to the appropriate offices so his crimes might be clearly declared.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Right Remonstrance Censor Zheng Shouyi submitted two memorials charging that during Zhang Yanze's tenure at Jingzhou he had broken the law, brutalized the people, dismembered secretary Zhang Shi and retainer Yang Hong, and others, and asking that the appropriate offices formally declare his crimes.

sentences.zh: 皆留中不出。

translations.literal: Both were kept within and not issued.
translations.idiomatic: Both memorials were kept within the palace and not released.

sentences.zh: 庚申，刑部郎中李濤、張麟，員外郎麻麟、王禧，同詣閣門上疏，論張彥澤罪犯，詞甚懇切。

translations.literal: On the gengshen day, Li Tao and Zhang Lin, Bureau Directors in the Ministry of Punishments, and Ma Lin and Wang Xi, assistant bureau directors, together went to the Gate Department and submitted memorials concerning Zhang Yanze's crimes; their language was very earnest.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Punishments Bureau Directors Li Tao and Zhang Lin, together with Assistant Bureau Directors Ma Lin and Wang Xi, went to the Gate Department and submitted forceful memorials on Zhang Yanze's crimes.

sentences.zh: 〈（《宋史·李濤傳》：涇帥張彥澤殺記室張式，奪其妻，式家人詣闕上訴，晉祖以彥澤有軍功，釋其罪。

translations.literal: (From the Biography of Li Tao in the History of Song: The military commander of Jing, Zhang Yanze, killed secretary Zhang Shi and seized his wife; Shi's family appealed at court, and the Jin Founder pardoned Yanze because of his military merit.
translations.idiomatic: (History of Song, Biography of Li Tao: Jing commander Zhang Yanze killed secretary Zhang Shi and seized his wife. Shi's family appealed at court, but the Jin Founder pardoned Yanze for his military merit.

sentences.zh: 濤伏閣抗疏，請置於法。

translations.literal: Tao prostrated himself at the gate and submitted a forceful memorial requesting that Yanze be punished according to law.
translations.idiomatic: Tao prostrated himself at the palace gate and submitted an urgent memorial demanding legal punishment.

sentences.zh: 晉祖召見諭之，濤植笏叩階，聲色俱厲，晉祖怒叱之，濤執笏如初。

translations.literal: The Jin Founder summoned him and admonished him; Tao held his tablet and knocked it on the steps, his voice and bearing both fierce; the Jin Founder angrily rebuked him, but Tao held his tablet as before.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin Founder summoned and admonished him. Tao gripped his tablet and struck the steps, voice and bearing fierce. The Jin Founder rebuked him angrily, but Tao held his tablet unchanged.

sentences.zh: 晉祖曰：「吾與彥澤有誓約，恕其死。」

translations.literal: The Jin Founder said: "I have a sworn bond with Yanze and forgive his death."
translations.idiomatic: The Jin Founder said, "I have sworn an oath with Yanze and will spare his life."

sentences.zh: 濤厲聲曰：「彥澤私誓，陛下不忍食其言；

translations.literal: Tao said fiercely: "Yanze's oath was private; Your Majesty cannot bear to break your word;
translations.idiomatic: Tao replied fiercely, "Yanze's oath was private. Your Majesty cannot bear to break your word;

sentences.zh: 範延光嘗賜鐵券，今復安在？」

translations.literal: Fan Yanguang once received an iron certificate—where is it now?"
translations.idiomatic: yet Fan Yanguang once received an iron certificate of immunity—where is it now?"

sentences.zh: 晉祖不能答，即拂衣起。）〉

translations.literal: The Jin Founder could not answer and immediately rose and left.)〉
translations.idiomatic: The Jin Founder had no reply and abruptly rose and left.)〉

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔：「張彥澤刳剔賓從，誅剝生聚，冤聲穢跡，流聞四方，章表繼來，指陳甚切。

translations.literal: On the xinyou day, an edict stated: "Zhang Yanze flayed and gouged his retainers, killed and stripped the living populace; cries of injustice and foul traces have spread in every direction, and memorials have kept arriving, pointing out the matter with great urgency.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, an edict declared: "Zhang Yanze flayed his retainers and extorted the living. Cries of injustice and foul deeds have spread everywhere, and urgent memorials have poured in.

sentences.zh: 尚以曾施微功，特示寬恩。

translations.literal: Still, because he once rendered slight merit, special leniency is shown.
translations.idiomatic: Yet because he once rendered slight service, special leniency is granted.

sentences.zh: 深懷曲法之慚，貴徇議勞之典。

translations.literal: We deeply feel shame at bending the law and honor the merit of those who remonstrated.
translations.idiomatic: We are deeply ashamed of bending the law and honor those who remonstrated.

sentences.zh: 其張彥澤宜削一階，仍降爵一紀。

translations.literal: Zhang Yanze should be reduced one rank step and his ennoblement lowered one grade.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yanze is to lose one rank step and have his ennoblement lowered one grade.

sentences.zh: 其張式宜贈官，張式父鐸、弟守貞、男希範並與除官。

translations.literal: Zhang Shi should receive a posthumous office; Zhang Shi's father Duo, his younger brother Shouzhen, and his son Xifan should all be given office.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shi is to receive a posthumous office, and his father Duo, his brother Shouzhen, and his son Xifan are all to be given appointments.

sentences.zh: 仍於涇州賜錢十萬，差人津置張式靈柩並骨肉歸鄉，所有先收納卻張式家財物畜，並令卻還。

translations.literal: One hundred thousand cash is also to be granted at Jingzhou, with men dispatched to escort Zhang Shi's coffin and his kin back to their home district; all household goods and livestock previously seized from Zhang Shi's family are to be returned.
translations.idiomatic: One hundred thousand cash is also granted at Jingzhou, with escorts to convey Zhang Shi's coffin and family home. All property and livestock seized from the Zhang household is to be returned.

sentences.zh: 其涇州新歸業戶，量與蠲減稅賦。」

translations.literal: For newly returned farming households at Jingzhou, taxes and levies are to be reduced and remitted as appropriate."
translations.idiomatic: Newly returned farming households at Jingzhou are to receive appropriate tax and levy relief."

sentences.zh: 翌日，以前涇州節度使張彥澤為左龍武大將軍。

translations.literal: The next day, Zhang Yanze, former military commissioner of Jingzhou, was made Grand General of the Left Dragon Martial Army.
translations.idiomatic: The next day, former Jingzhou commissioner Zhang Yanze was appointed Grand General of the Left Dragon Martial Army.

sentences.zh: 〈（《宋史·楊昭儉傳》：昭儉與李濤論張彥澤不報，會有詔命朝臣轉對，或有封事，亦許以不時條奏。

translations.literal: (From the Biography of Yang Zhaojian in the History of Song: Zhaojian, together with Li Tao, discussed Zhang Yanze without receiving a response; then an edict ordered court officials to rotate in presenting remonstrance, and if there were sealed memorials, they were also permitted to submit items of business at any time.
translations.idiomatic: (History of Song, Biography of Yang Zhaojian: Zhaojian and Li Tao raised Zhang Yanze without response. Then an edict ordered court officials to rotate in presenting remonstrance and permitted sealed memorials to be submitted at any time.

sentences.zh: 昭儉復上疏曰：「天子君臨四海，日有萬幾，懋建諍臣，彌縫其闕。

translations.literal: Zhaojian again submitted a memorial stating: "The Son of Heaven presides over the four seas; affairs number in the tens of thousands each day; remonstrating officials should be vigorously established to mend its gaps.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaojian submitted another memorial: "The Son of Heaven rules the four seas, and ten thousand affairs press each day. Remonstrating officials should be vigorously appointed to mend the court's gaps.

sentences.zh: 今則諫臣雖設，言路不通。

translations.literal: Now remonstrators exist in name, but the path of speech is blocked.
translations.idiomatic: Now remonstrators exist in name, but the path of speech is blocked.

sentences.zh: 藥石之論，不達於聖聰，而邪佞之徒，取容於左右。

translations.literal: Counsel harsh as medicine and stone does not reach the sacred ears, while wicked flatterers find favor at the emperor's side.
translations.idiomatic: Salutary counsel never reaches the throne, while wicked flatterers win favor at the emperor's side.

sentences.zh: 御史臺紀綱之府，彈糾之司。

translations.literal: The Censorate is the house of discipline and the office of impeachment.
translations.idiomatic: The Censorate is the house of discipline and the office of impeachment.

sentences.zh: 銜冤者固當昭雪，為蠹者難免放流。

translations.literal: Those bearing wrongs should naturally be vindicated, and those who are parasites can hardly escape banishment.
translations.idiomatic: The wronged should be vindicated, and parasites should not escape banishment.

sentences.zh: 陛下臨御以來，寬仁太甚，徒置兩司，殆如虛器。

translations.literal: Since Your Majesty began to rule, leniency has been excessive, and the two offices are nearly empty vessels.
translations.idiomatic: Since Your Majesty began to rule, leniency has been excessive, and the two offices are nearly empty vessels.

sentences.zh: 遂令節使慢侮朝章，屠害幕吏。

translations.literal: Thus military commissioners contemptuously violate court regulations and slaughter staff officers.
translations.idiomatic: Thus military commissioners scorn court law and slaughter staff officers.

sentences.zh: 始訴冤於丹闕，反執送於本藩，茍安跋扈之心，莫恤冤抑之苦。

translations.literal: They first appeal for justice at the imperial court, then are sent back to their home circuits; they secure arrogant hearts and give no thought to the suffering of the wronged.
translations.idiomatic: Victims first appeal at court, then are sent back to their home circuits. The arrogant grow bolder, and no one heeds the suffering of the wronged.
